dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing of the 2D dorsal silhouette from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast, dark longitudinal linear mark is centrally located along the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear topological disruption along the central dorsal axis, appearing as a dark, shadow-casting furrow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent elongated dark mark, consistent with a significant longitudinal scar or lesion, extending along the mid-dorsal line.
